_about: Five voyages worked out step by step from data/submarines.json (design step S1, blueprint rule 7). Each voyage gives the build, the route, the expected figures and the working. Return times use the community formula in the data file's 'formula' table and stay labelled "calculated, not yet confirmed" until the owner's game times agree (design risk R1). Experience is the game table's base reward; the community source says high survey stats can raise it by 25% to 100% per sector, so the rank after is a floor (the data file's formula.experienceNote).

voyages.title: A new submarine's first voyage

Leg 1 range: 191.9844 x 0.035 = 6.7195, rounded down 6; plus survey distance 10 = 16.
Survey of A: 180 min x 7000 / (110 x 100) x 60 = 6872.7273, rounded down 6,872 s.
Voyage: legs and surveys 11,050 s + fixed 43,200 s = 54,250 s = 15 h 04 min 10 s.
Rank walk: rank 1 with 0 already into the rank, plus 10,610 = 10,610.
Rank after: 2, with 4,430 of 12,504 toward the next rank.
notes: The starting build every new submarine has (four Shark-class parts) and the first sector of the first sea.

Which sea the owner's "OJ" means is still the owner's to confirm (design question Q1).
